messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: P0 - elevated 5xx spike in api-gateway (us-west-2). Error rate ~22% over 3m. Paging @carla_oncall. /incident create

carla_oncall: ack, I'm on it. Starting mitigation: enabling fallback route to model-compact and increasing gateway worker concurrency. Will upload logs and post correlation IDs.

ryan_sre: oncall - please drop a sample corr id + s3 path to the log bundle so I can start the timeline. Also want to know if retries are amplifying the spike.

carla_oncall: sample corr id: corr=6a4b2f9c. logs uploaded: s3://redwood-kvlogs/incidents/2958765432.tar.gz. kvlog id: kv-2026-03-17-11. Quick grep shows repeated upstream timeouts for that corrid, posting snippet.

carla_oncall: ```
# klog query --corrid 6a4b2f9c --since 5m
[2026-03-17T11:02:12Z] gateway: req=abc123 corr=6a4b2f9c status=502 upstream="model-pool-1" err="upstream read timeout"
[2026-03-17T11:02:12Z] upstream: attempt=1 resp=504
[2026-03-17T11:02:13Z] gateway: retrying routing -> model-compact
[2026-03-17T11:02:13Z] gateway: req=abc123 corr=6a4b2f9c status=200 duration=250ms
```

nate_eng: customer impact note: two mid-market customers (acme-inc, safepay) saw elevated errors. Support tickets: #SUP-1289, #SUP-1290. Ballpark ~3k failed requests during peak window.

sophia_prodops: proposed RCA plan: 1) timeline (owner: @ryan_sre) 2) hypothesis tracking (owner: @carla_oncall) 3) surface upstream retry/circuit-breaker behavior and per-node failure distribution. Can someone pull aggregate upstream 504 vs gateway 502?

ryan_sre: pulling aggregates now. Early numbers: upstream 504s account for ~18% of error events, gateway 502/502-mapping shows ~80% (suggests gateway is surfacing upstream faults + retry mapping). Also seeing corrids with retry loops -> possible amplification. I'll add per-node heatmap to the RCA doc.

carla_oncall: created draft RCA page: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INC-2958765432 (editing). Added kvlog index and initial timeline. Plan to keep fallback enabled for 15m and watch error rate. If errors <3% for 10m, start rollback.

logs_bot: Uploaded diagnostic bundle: https://logs.redwood.ai/bundle/2958765432 (kvlog + traces + request-samples).

ryan_sre: :eyes: annotated timeline and added initial hypothesis H1: model-pool soft limits -> increased latency -> gateway retries -> amplified 5xx. Marking H1 in the RCA doc and attaching query results.

carla_oncall: :white_check_mark: mitigation holding. Monitoring dashboards show error rate down to ~6% and trending. Will stay on until stable. Posting any new corrids here for tracebacks. TTY until stable.
